title: Maestra's Post
wikitext:
[[File:Maestra's Post.jpg|thumb|Maestra's Post]]
'''Maestra's Post''' is located in western [[Ashenvale]], south of [[the Ruins of Ordil'Aran]] and northwest of [[Astranaar]]. It is a small camp consisting of a tower and a large [[night elven]] building. It is also home to several quest givers, including [[Ashenvale]]'s only population of [[human]]s - [[Feero Ironhand]] and [[Delgren the Purifier]].

Due to the low level of the NPCs here, Horde players often come to spawncamp [[Feero Ironhand]] and the other two with him.
